schemes.title: Government Schemes
schemes.subtitle: Stay updated with the latest agricultural schemes and subsidies

list.title: PM Dhan Dhaanya Krishi Yojana
list.description: A major new scheme aimed at transforming agriculture across 100 districts. It focuses on enhancing productivity, crop diversification, and improving irrigation and storage.

list.title: Mission for Aatmanirbharta in Pulses
list.description: This mission aims to make India self-reliant in pulses (like tur, urad, and masoor). It improves productivity, expands cultivation area, and strengthens the value chain.

list.title: Tripura's ARC Potato Cultivation Scheme
list.description: Provides 6,000 farmers with ₹2,000 in direct financial support and ₹1,000 in agricultural materials to adopt the high-yield ARC (Aeroponic Rooted Cutting) method for potato farming.

list.title: Rural Prosperity and Resilience Programme
list.description: A new multi-sectoral initiative to address underemployment in the agriculture sector through skilling, investment, and technology.

list.title: National Mission on High Yielding Seeds
list.description: Focused on strengthening research and commercial availability of high-yield, pest-resistant, and climate-resilient seeds to boost crop output.

list.title: Revised National Programme for Dairy Development
list.description: Key additions approved to improve milk procurement, processing capacity, and market access for dairy farmers.

list.title: Revised Rashtriya Gokul Mission
list.description: Updated with new components, including one-time assistance for heifer rearing centers and interest subvention for farmers purchasing high-genetic-merit heifers.

list.title: Krishi Udaan 2.0
list.description: Facilitates the transport of agricultural produce (especially perishables) by air to strengthen market access for farmers in remote and northeastern regions.

list.title: PM Matsya Sampada Yojana (Upgraded)
list.description: Received significant upgrades including new support for technology adoption in aquaculture (like sensors and aerators) and grants for modern fish landing centers.

list.title: Agricultural Technology Management Agency (ATMA)
list.description: Promotes farmer-centric extension services and received a major update solidifying its role in disseminating modern agricultural technology.
